{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Aeson
import Data.Aeson.Types (parseMaybe)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy as TL
import qualified Data.HashMap.Strict as HM
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import Control.Concurrent.Async (async, wait)
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import GHC.Generics
import Network.HTTP.Types.Status

-- Simulated MongoDB-like document store
type Document = Object
type Collection = [Document]

data AppState = AppState
  { users :: IORef Collection
  , queryLog :: MVar [Value]
  }

-- Query evaluation engine
data QueryOp = Eq T.Text Value
             | Gt T.Text Value
             | Lt T.Text Value
             | Or [[(T.Text, Value)]]
             | Raw Value
             deriving (Show)

-- Parse a query document into operations
parseQuery :: Value -> [QueryOp]
parseQuery (Object obj) = concatMap parseField (HM.toList obj)
  where
    parseField ("$or", Array arr) = [Or $ map extractPairs (toList arr)]
    parseField (key, Object nested) = concatMap (parseNested key) (HM.toList nested)
    parseField (key, val) = [Eq key val]
    
    parseNested key ("$gt", val) = [Gt key val]
    parseNested key ("$lt", val) = [Lt key val]
    parseNested key ("$eq", val) = [Eq key val]
    parseNested key (_, val) = [Eq key val]
    
    extractPairs (Object o) = HM.toList o
    extractPairs _ = []
    
    toList (Array v) = foldr (:) [] v
    toList _ = []
parseQuery val = [Raw val]

-- Evaluate a query against a document
evalQuery :: [QueryOp] -> Document -> Bool
evalQuery ops doc = all (evalOp doc) ops

evalOp :: Document -> QueryOp -> Bool
evalOp doc (Eq key val) = HM.lookup key doc == Just val
evalOp doc (Gt key val) = case (HM.lookup key doc, val) of
  (Just (Number a), Number b) -> a > b
  _ -> False
evalOp doc (Lt key val) = case (HM.lookup key doc, val) of
  (Just (Number a), Number b) -> a < b
  _ -> False
evalOp doc (Or clauses) = any (\clause -> all (\(k,v) -> HM.lookup k doc == Just v) clause) clauses
evalOp _ (Raw _) = True

-- Sanitize field names to prevent operator injection
sanitizeFieldName :: T.Text -> T.Text
sanitizeFieldName name
  | T.isPrefixOf "$" name = T.drop 1 name
  | otherwise = name

-- Build query from user-supplied filter parameters
buildUserQuery :: Value -> Value
buildUserQuery (Object params) = Object $ HM.mapWithKey transformParam sanitized
  where
    sanitized = HM.filterWithKey (\k _ -> not (T.isPrefixOf "$" k)) params
    transformParam :: T.Text -> Value -> Value
    transformParam key val = val
buildUserQuery v = v

-- Async query execution with logging
execQuery :: AppState -> Value -> IO Collection
execQuery state rawQuery = do
  let query = buildUserQuery rawQuery
  -- Log query asynchronously
  logTask <- async $ do
    modifyMVar_ (queryLog state) $ \logs -> return (query : logs)
  
  -- Execute query
  docs <- readIORef (users state)
  let ops = parseQuery query
  let results = filter (evalQuery ops) docs
  
  -- Wait for log to complete
  wait logTask
  return results

-- Input validation layer
validateSearchInput :: Value -> Either T.Text Value
validateSearchInput (Object obj) = 
  if HM.size obj > 10
    then Left "Too many query parameters"
    else if any (\v -> depth v > 4) (HM.elems obj)
      then Left "Query too deeply nested"
      else Right (Object obj)
  where
    depth :: Value -> Int
    depth (Object o) = 1 + maximum (0 : map depth (HM.elems o))
    depth (Array a) = 1 + maximum (0 : map depth (foldr (:) [] a))
    depth _ = 0
validateSearchInput _ = Left "Query must be an object"

main :: IO ()
main = do
  usersRef <- newIORef sampleUsers
  logVar <- newMVar []
  let state = AppState usersRef logVar
  
  scotty 3000 $ do
    -- Search endpoint
    post "/api/users/search" $ do
      body <- jsonData :: ActionM Value
      case validateSearchInput body of
        Left err -> do
          status badRequest400
          json $ object ["error" .= err]
        Right validQuery -> do
          results <- liftIO $ execQuery state validQuery
          json (map filterSensitive results)
    
    -- Get user by username
    get "/api/users/:username" $ do
      uname <- param "username"
      let query = object ["username" .= (uname :: TL.Text)]
      results <- liftIO $ execQuery state query
      case results of
        [] -> status notFound404
        (doc:_) -> json (filterSensitive doc)

filterSensitive :: Document -> Document
filterSensitive = HM.filterWithKey (\k _ -> k `notElem` ["password_hash", "internal_id"])

sampleUsers :: Collection
sampleUsers =
  [ HM.fromList [("username", String "admin"), ("role", String "admin"), ("password_hash", String "$2b$12$abc"), ("email", String "admin@example.com")]
  , HM.fromList [("username", String "alice"), ("role", String "user"), ("password_hash", String "$2b$12$def"), ("email", String "alice@example.com")]
  , HM.fromList [("username", String "bob"), ("role", String "user"), ("password_hash", String "$2b$12$ghi"), ("email", String "bob@example.com")]
  ]
